meta.name: create-a-small-plan
meta.description: Create a small Prime Agent plan before implementation. Use for small scoped repo changes needing 1 to 3 planning questions and one reviewer or criticizer refinement pass; exclude direct implementation-only, factual/explanation, trivial command-only, or explicit no-plan requests.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 动手前制定小而精的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常在动手前需要先把小改动梳理成计划。
copy.tagline_en: Draft a small, focused plan before making code changes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you like to map out changes before editing code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在改代码前会先创建一份小型计划:只读检查仓库,逐一提出 1~3 个规划问题,写出 PLAN_v1.md,再进行一轮评审修订,必要时生成 v2,最后询问是否直接执行。
howto.when: 当用户请求对小型仓库改动先做规划时触发(典型:改动范围小、决策点少);直接实现、事实问答、琐碎命令等不需计划的请求不触发。

say.text: 帮我对这个仓库改动做个小计划。
say.note: Claude 会先检查仓库再问规划问题。

say.text: 先规划一下这个改动,再动手改。
say.note: 它会生成 PLAN_v1.md 并安排一轮评审。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will create a small Prime Agent plan before repo changes: it inspects the repo read-only, asks 1–3 planning questions, writes PLAN_v1.md, runs one reviewer/criticizer refinement pass, revises to v2 if needed, then asks about execution.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a small plan for a scoped repo change (small scope, few decisions). Direct implementation, factual/explanation, trivial commands, or explicit no-plan requests are excluded.

say_en.text: Make a small plan for this repo change.
say_en.note: Claude will inspect the repo and ask planning questions.

say_en.text: Plan this change before you start coding.
say_en.note: It will create PLAN_v1.md and run one review round.
